## Current release route — #533 reconciliation, 2026-10-11

The [M7 milestone body](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/milestone/7) is the ordered queue. [The complete disposition table and proposed source plan](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/next/docs/releases/next-candidate-scope.md) cover the original18 open M7 issues and four open bugs and every original contract section. Original P0–P6 sections are archived, not current M7 phase numbers.

1. Combined GENERIC_X64 image20 is qualified: source1a02664844, identity0.0.1-dev+20261011T194522Z.g1a0266484423, bundlebd85b1b42f01. Installed readiness/USB/naming/INFORMATION, clean/public-config/retained-storage,324local protocol assertions, reviewed frames and final composed1378host checks are source-bound in`docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-pixelelated-replacement-20/`. Original failed aggregates remain unchanged.
2. Independent audit#553 and four repairs#554 are complete; published9f170ee741 and completionbc9dfe8141. Exact tracker readbacks/marker and full local ceremony pass; both final hosted checks pass. No confirmed product defect; five existing#528 publication criteria remain partial.
3. #555 Both refreshed handheld builds and independent artifact acceptance are COMPLETE, from audited bc9dfe8141 with shared identity `0.0.1-dev+20261011T222153Z.gbc9dfe8141d9`. H700 build ended0 at22:51:17UTC and acceptance04 at22:54:47UTC; both DDR variants/update and186 ARM files pass. SM8550 build05 ended0 at23:31:03UTC and acceptance05 at23:31:43UTC; raw/update equality, GPT, all five ABL package files,14 FEX outputs and188 ARM files pass. All original successful-run channels0, actual owners exited, containers removed and acceptance scratch removed. Box86 differences are bounded date/time/revision metadata only; added popt is exact from package staging through ARM and installed firmware. H700 bundle66273ff16383957687af44728a9e4e2c4bf1242c0217cf681dca8abee858d9b7; SM8550 bundlea480210cd8837f20fb67a80508c517308cc0326ed2c1544493e3f56d125f1f2f. Evidence: `docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-device-refresh/`. #556 RG35XX SP transfer and one reboot are COMPLETE and accepted. Exact installed system/kernel/DTB/DDR4 bootloader/ES/both RetroArch hashes match; queue empty, original mounts, active frontend/zero restarts. All163 protected files, three recovery entries and every current configuration/credential/path are preserved. Automatic cloud sync remains off; device returned to owner use. No screenshot/input/game/audio/cloud operation or further physical-device authority is implied. Next: #493 remains the next host task: classify superseded roots/firmware and source-custody dependencies, prepare guarded retirement, then remeasure capacity. Current host availability is647,420,825,600bytes (about603GiB). No old deletion batch is replayed or widened. Current H700 supports owner testing; current SM8550 is held for its next named physical test. Large historical artifacts are not permanent fallbacks. Physical/publication holds stay explicit; no public RC is allocated.
4. Finish #528 source/licence/retrieval/off-host custody, security/custody readback, #337/#359/#265 adoption/recovery/support/branding/source notes, channel separation and separately qualified asset/publication gates. No RC or publication claim.

## Accepted baseline — retain, do not replay

Replacement18 distribution7f58b7b1c5 / ES1d76b3da7d:13 unaffected suites plus #527 corrected walks/composed78 frames; qa21 original rc1 unchanged;324 local protocol assertions;31 actual retained-storage upgrade checks; installed CF10 public/default/custom/root preservation. #507/#524 and earlier #471 reviews are complete for their sources. #492 H700/SM8550 artifacts and all three approved owner deployments are complete; #519 alignment is complete. Owner devices are in use. Nova's unassigned early GPU/SMMU observations are separate from #529's proved generic readiness defect.

## Remaining acceptance criteria

- [x] Freeze receipt names exact clean source/pins/container/time/qualifier, source index and unchanged upstream base; any #528/#536/#537 firmware delta is reviewed first. #493 capacity record and actual watcher/command identities precede launch. Evidence: qualified image20 receipts above; #553 verified source/audit binding. Refreshed handheld packaging remains #555.
- [x] Combined-image installed #529 readiness, #531 USB revision and #530/#532 version/asset/INFORMATION checks pass with original logs, manifests and reviewed frames. Evidence: qualified image20 receipts above; #553 verified source/audit binding. Refreshed handheld packaging remains #555.
- [x] Clean/public ROCKNIX configuration and actual retained-storage upgrade preserve settings/payload/credentials/selected paths; all applicable standard VM suites, #536 pointer/navigation and #537 connection-lifecycle controls, image equality/sweeps and #349/#350 branch proofs pass with exact-source frame/flow index and applicable delta review. No known bug remains at RC designation. Evidence: qualified image20 receipts above; #553 verified source/audit binding. Refreshed handheld packaging remains #555.
- [ ] #528 actual component/source inventory is reconciled for final bytes; all source/licence dispositions, independent retrieval/hash proof and off-host custody are recorded.
- [ ] P1 security/custody evidence records bot repository-permission/expiry inventory and expiry-notice mechanism, and remote runner trusted-trigger/isolation or disabled-runner fallback. Local absence or403 is insufficient; secrets are never included in public evidence. Existing token identity migration is complete.
- [ ] #337/#359/#265 publication evidence includes placeholder receipt/status, support matrix, manual adoption/recovery, unchanged SSH password, trust assumption, source/licence links, lineage/non-endorsement, cloud selected-path/setup and same-model restore instructions, compatibility and redirect dependency. Live broader guides/QR work stays #511; no broken QR is enabled.
- [ ] Each proposed attached asset matches the selected input set or has explicit requalification, current hashes/size-limit/sweeps, per-SoC boot/recovery matrix and named physical smoke evidence before attachment (D-WORKFLOW-120). Untested assets stay held.
- [ ] Immutable allocated tag/assets and independent retrieval receipt satisfy #265/D-WORKFLOW-159; draft/RC/dev are excluded from the stable channel. Release reassembly is qualified independently of its predecessor RC.
- [ ] Named publication authority is recorded before the public action; until then status is immutable engineering/candidate preparation only.

## Transferred or retired scope

#352's unrelated-folder bug is delivered; its public folder-selection documentation is now explicitly above and in #511. #353 automatic migration is retired. #354 consolidates here; #510 product contract is delivered. #349/#350 retain only explicit missing proof/docs. No old checkbox calls for discovery, moving ROMs, joining/following cloud roots or owner-specific remediation.

Original P0 foundation analyses are completed dated records. Original P1 repository/container/source/lock gates map to freeze and custody above. Original P2 X64 and P2b/P3 device gates map to image/asset proof above. Original P4 publication is retained above. Original post-release P5/P6 tasks remain later: #341 when a real allowlist need arises, cadence/hostedQA/redirect follow-up, #336/#339/#346 feasibility/review/interchange. D-INFRA-022 governs retention now; no timing threshold is weakened. Fork-to-fork0.0.2 remains a future release gate.

Disconnected notifications #395, observability #432, broader site #511, name cleanup #509 and private cleanup/redundancy #516/#518 are separate. The main agent actively supervises each next long job and consumes original completion/failure channels. No build or test is currently running.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes. Retained synthetic proof is reviewed here; any missing software assertion belongs on the next combined candidate. No personal cloud or owner-device action.

[Disposition and next-build plan](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/next/docs/releases/next-candidate-scope.md); [replacement18 qualification](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/next/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-08-pixelelated-replacement-18/qualification.md).


## Original request and history

The complete original body and every comment are preserved in [the #533 snapshot](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/next/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-candidate-scope/tracker-before.json), entry #344. Retired criteria there are historical, not an execution queue. Existing GitHub comments also remain intact.
